Metadata.title: FoodSource
Metadata.description: Find and compare food suppliers for restaurants, manufacturers, and procurement teams.

Footer.note: Demonstration catalog. Prices, contacts, and certifications are fabricated and are not commercial offers.

Landing.title: Find food suppliers and compare their terms
Landing.subtitle: FoodSource is for reviewing suppliers by product, category, and city, comparing terms, and keeping a shortlist. Catalog records are labeled as demonstration data.

Landing.compareText: Place up to three suppliers side by side.
Landing.saveText: Keep a shortlist with notes and a contact status for the demo workspace.
Landing.productTypesText: Open the catalog by the kind of goods: ingredients, finished products, packaging, or other food-production supplies.
Landing.categoriesText: Choose a category to open the catalog filtered to that group.

Profile.errorText: This supplier could not be read. Open the page again.

Compare.title: Comparison
Compare.description: Select up to three suppliers and compare the facts on record. The match score shows which of those facts could be used.
Compare.disclaimer: The highest score does not guarantee the best supplier. Missing prices, minimum orders, certificates, and delivery terms stay unknown and are not treated as verified.
Compare.legend: Highlighting is used only when the same unit can be compared and one figure is lower. It is not a company audit.
Compare.statusLegend: Points were earned toward the score. 0 pts is a mismatch and it counts. Unavailable data is not a mismatch and adds no points, so gaps keep the score below 100. Not comparable means the figures cannot be lined up. Not requested means that criterion was left out of the score.
Compare.basisFromSearch: This score uses the last search from the catalog.
Compare.basisAmongSelection: No catalog search is stored. Shared categories can be compared. Location and delivery to a place were not requested.
Compare.deliveryUnverified: Stated on the record, not a verified delivery promise
Compare.exportFailed: The comparison file could not be created. Try again.
Compare.lowerPrice: Lower price in the same unit
Compare.lowerMoq: Lower minimum order in the same unit
Compare.emptyText: Add up to three suppliers from the catalog.
Compare.errorText: The selected suppliers could not be read.

reasons.category_match: A product is in the requested category.
reasons.category_miss: No product is in the requested category.
reasons.product_text: A product or category matches the search text.
reasons.name_only: Only the supplier name matches, not a product.
reasons.no_product_match: No product matches the search text.
reasons.shared_category: Shares a product category with another selected supplier.
reasons.different_categories: No product category in common with the other selected suppliers.
reasons.no_shared_category: These suppliers do not share a product category, so product fit was not scored.
reasons.partial_location: Only part of the requested location matches.
reasons.location_miss: The location does not match the request.
reasons.location_text: The location matches the search text.
reasons.location_unavailable: The requested location is not recorded.
reasons.no_location_requested: No location was requested, so geography was not scored.
reasons.lower_is_better: Compared within the same unit. A lower figure scores higher. This is not a confirmed offer.
reasons.within_limit: Within the requested limit. A lower figure scores higher. This is not a confirmed offer.
reasons.price_unavailable: No price is recorded, so price was not scored and was not treated as low or verified.
reasons.moq_unavailable: No minimum order is recorded, so it was not scored.
reasons.different_unit: The unit differs from the compared unit, so this figure was not scored.
reasons.no_peer_value: No second supplier uses the same unit, so this figure was not compared.
reasons.verified: A current certificate has been verified by FoodSource. This is not a guarantee about the supplier.
reasons.unverified_not_counted: Certificate claims are listed, but verification is unfinished, so they stay unknown and are not counted.
reasons.unverified_partial: A certificate is claimed, but it is not verified, so the claim is only a partial match.
reasons.expired_not_verified: The recorded certificate is expired and was not counted as current.
reasons.suspended_not_current: The certificate is suspended and was not counted as current.
reasons.revoked_not_current: The certificate is revoked and was not counted as current.
reasons.rejected_not_counted: Verification rejected the evidence, so the certificate was not counted.
reasons.no_certification_records: No certificate is recorded. That absence was not treated as verified or as a failure.
reasons.demonstration_not_evidence: Demonstration records are not evidence of a certificate, so they were not scored.
reasons.stated_for_requested_place_unverified: The delivery text mentions the requested place. It was not treated as verified coverage.
reasons.stated_but_place_not_mentioned: Delivery text does not mention the requested place and was not treated as verified coverage.
reasons.delivery_not_stated: No delivery terms are recorded, so coverage was not scored.
reasons.delivery_not_requested: Delivery text is present, but no destination was requested. It was not treated as verified coverage and was not scored.
